import os
from PIL import Image
import subprocess

def resize_images(image_filenames, input_dir, output_dir, size):
    if not os.path.exists(output_dir):
        os.makedirs(output_dir)

    resized_filenames = []
    for filename in image_filenames:
        input_path = os.path.join(input_dir, filename)
        output_path = os.path.join(output_dir, filename)
        
        # Resize image using Pillow
        with Image.open(input_path) as img:
            img = img.resize(size, Image.ANTIALIAS)
            img.save(output_path)
        
        # Optionally, use subprocess to call an external tool like ImageMagick
        # command = ['convert', input_path, '-resize', f'{size[0]}x{size[1]}', output_path]
        # subprocess.run(command, check=True)
        
        resized_filenames.append(filename)
    
    return resized_filenames
